youtube.title: What's the rear view mirror tab for? #shorts
youtube.description:
What does the rear view mirror tab do? The mirror glass isn't flat: it's a wedge, with a shiny mirror layer behind it. So how does a day night mirror work? In the day the shiny back reflects the road straight at you. Flip the tab and the whole mirror tilts: the shiny back now points at the roof, and you only see the weak reflection off the front of the glass, about four percent of the light. That's rear view mirror night mode: headlights go dim, but you still see them.
